name: Sugar Megarush

features.name: Variable reel sizes
features.description: Each reel shows between four and nine symbols on every spin, changing the shape of the grid.

features.name: Marked-spot multipliers
features.description: Winning symbols mark their positions; a win on a marked spot adds a multiplier that doubles up to 2,048x.

features.name: Treble Free Spins
features.description: A Treble Scatter in the triggering combination makes multiplier spots triple on consecutive wins, up to 2,187x.

review:
Sugar Megarush is Pragmatic Play's candy slot with reels that change size every spin, from four to nine symbols each, so the grid never looks the same twice. Wins come from clusters of five or more matching symbols, paying up to 150x, and winning symbols explode and mark their positions. Land another winning symbol on a marked spot in the same spin and a multiplier appears, starting at 2x and doubling each time up to 2,048x.

Three or more scatters trigger free spins with 10 to 30 spins, and the marked spots keep their multipliers for the whole feature. If one of the triggering scatters is a Treble Scatter, you get Treble Free Spins, where multiplier values triple on consecutive wins and can reach 2,187x. The free demo is the right way to learn how the shifting reel sizes move multipliers around; it's a tumble slot for players who enjoyed Sugar Rush and want a bigger, less predictable grid.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
